title: 第11章 疯狂的刘隆
content_zh:
执法队开始搜查张家老宅。
结果自然是一无所获，张家并没有任何有价值的东西。
但是刘隆明白，暗中人在这盯梢很久，绝对不可能没重要东西，或者说对方是在等人？
等谁来张家？
然而，已经无人的张家，谁会来这，除了李皓这个还关心案子的家伙。
身材高大的刘隆，背负双手，在宅院中四处游荡。
李皓几人跟在后面，至于黑豹，一直也没走，只是此刻不敢靠近刘隆，好像颇为惧怕这位执法队长。
很快，刘隆靠近了厨房。
厨房门已经被
李皓没有看烟囱，烟囱那边，一块石头被他替换了下来，李皓尽量做到还原了，只是烟囱外刷的那层石灰早已掉落，这个是没办法再弄上去的。
年久失修的厨房，掉落一些石灰好像也很正常。
其他人几乎不会抬头去看，也不会太过在意。
刘隆的目光，则是极为犀利，一眼扫过，整个厨房的布局映入眼帘，他也没指望在这发现什么，更没指望被人盯了这么久，此地真有什么宝物等着他来寻找。
正准备收回目光，刘隆视线微微一滞，在李皓换下的石块那边，微微停留了瞬间。
很快，刘隆移开了视线。
没有多说什么，转身，看了一眼李皓，有些俯视的意味，冷淡道：“李皓，你来的时候，有什么发现吗？”
“没有！”
李皓摇头，想了想又补充道：“也不是一点没有，根据我的观察，整个房屋都被人动过，甚至院子中那棵老树都曾被人挖起过。”
“动静不小，却是没人知晓，不是实力强，就是遮掩能力强！”
刘隆微微点头。

忽然又道：“你觉得，拆了张家，幕后之人，会不会现身？”
“大概不会！”
李皓选择了实话实说，“就算拆了张家，执法队在这，对方哪怕实力强，也不敢轻易现身，那就不是暗中行事，而是和整个银城作对了！”
“那你觉得，还有必要继续拆了这老屋吗？这可是你好友留下的祖宅。”
李皓提起了精神，刘隆是发现了什么吗？
是怀疑自己，还是怀疑红影势力拿走了什么？
很可能是怀疑自己！
无他，红影所在的势力，到今天为止，还在派人盯梢，真要拿走了什么，也许就没必要继续留下来了。
那么说，刘隆真的可能怀疑到了自己。
“真够难缠的！”
这么难缠的一号人物，为何这一年来，给李皓的印象却是有些无能？
执法队这边，没破获的案子不是一两件，否则单纯的自焚案，李皓也不会觉得执法队无能。
李皓思考一番，有些迟疑道：“若是能留下最好，若是无法留下，只要能抓到凶手，能给张远报仇，那宅子是死物，拆了也好，烧了也罢，我都没意见！”
“说的不错！”
刘隆微微点头，下一刻，陡然一拳打出，打的厨房墙壁上直接出现一个窟窿，看的李皓心中一颤。
这厨房墙壁，虽说不是铜墙铁壁，那也是砖块砌成的。
刘隆一拳下去，直接打的砖块断裂，出现一个坑洞，就冲这一点，李皓明白，自己被他砸一拳，不死也残。
年久失修的厨房，被刘隆一拳打出了窟窿，也震荡的整个厨房墙壁上石灰四处掉落。
刘隆冷冷扫了一眼四周，淡淡道：“既然没查到什么，就不浪费时间了，拆了屋子！掘地三尺，挖挖看，如果还是没有发现，那就点火烧！一把火烧了，还是没发现，那就罢了！”
“是！”

四周，执法队队员们纷纷应和，很快，轰隆声响起。
刘隆再次看向李皓，淡淡道：“要不要去找找，留下几样物件，做个念想？”
李皓轻轻摇头，叹息一声，有些消沉道：“不用！没意义！取下凶手的脑袋，将其送到张远墓前，更有价值一些！”
此刻，李皓岂会引火上身。
带走几样东西，那整个张家没了其他东西，就剩下李皓带走的那几样，到时候就是黄泥掉裤裆，不是屎也是屎了。
红影一方一直没找到张家的刀，到了那时候，恐怕会觉得，李皓带走的东西，就有张家的刀了。
偏偏，李皓还真有！
刘隆这话，未必安了好心啊。
也许是试探，也许干脆就是借刀杀人，反正李皓不接这茬。
刘隆眼中忽然露出微不可见的笑意，下一刻，高声喝道：“不要全部砸了烧了，带几样东西回巡检司，当证物！”
李皓没说话。
而是迅速判断刘隆的意思，这是想引诱红影一方上钩？
此刻，他再也不会小看执法队，小看刘隆，而是仔细去分析他每一句话的意思。
“其他人散了，四处找找！李皓，你跟着我！”
刘隆遣散了身边其他队员，喊上了李皓。
李皓不问什么，只是乖乖执行命令，迅速跟上刘隆。
刘隆什么也不说，大跨步朝外走去。
李皓马上跟上，连走带跑地才能跟着。
张家门外。
整个大街上，此刻到处都是人，有执法队的人，也有被惊动的老街住户，虽然搬走了许多，此地还是有一些人留下的。

刘隆一言不发，继续迈步前行。
一直走到老街中央的一处水塔之下，这才停下了脚步，接着跨步进入水塔，直接朝水塔上方走去。
李皓再次跟上。
他有些不明白这位的意思，也不清楚刘隆为何要来这。
登高望远？
这里是整个老街最高的建筑，倒是可以看清四周，是来观察敌人在哪吗？
沿着木质的楼梯，伴随着吱呀吱呀的声音，两人一路向上，片刻后，登上了塔顶。
下方，老街尽在眼下。
刘隆穿着黑色风衣，风衣随风飘荡，露出了风衣内部那密密麻麻的兵器，出乎李皓的意料，不是枪械，而是各种冷兵器。
一把短刀，一柄精致的银色小斧头，还有一些刀柄极小的飞刀。
刘隆仰头看向天空，并未看向人头攒动的老街，声音淡漠道：“李皓，你是机要室巡检，我问你，你来巡检司一年，对执法队最大的印象是什么？”
“能干！”
李皓毫不迟疑。
“呵！”
冷笑声传来，刘隆面露讥嘲之色，“虚伪！文人都是如此！”
“……”
无言以对。
刘隆淡漠道：“是无能才对！破一些鸡毛蒜皮的小案子还行，大案几乎十件九不破！”
“但是，你要知道，巡检司执法队，其实也就最近一些年，有些无能，前些年，银城巡检司，就是银城的定海神针！”
“你是银城人，当知道，在你小时候，银城的治安，是附近所有城市中最安全的，夜不闭户都行！”

李皓想了想，点点头。
也是，小时候的银城，好像的确很安全。
当然，也可能和小时候没有接触这些有关，那时候的他觉得，银城是很安全的，不会有任何危险。
刘隆不管他想些什么，忽然又道：“你知道，我为何想让你进入执法队吗？”
“不知……”
“因为张远！”
“……”
李皓皱眉，什么意思？
刘隆语气平静：“执法队，我当了十年队长，有感情了！就如你对张远一般，我对执法队也有兄弟情，不忍心见到这个兄弟渐渐死去！”
“我也曾想拯救，结果发现，当局者迷，我已经无法清晰地用自己的理智去掌握感情！我对每个人都很了解，但是，也正因为这种了解，让我觉得，执法队的任何人，都不会作出对不起我的事！”
“我不愿去怀疑任何人，不愿去相信，当年和我同生共死的兄弟，如今会为了一些钱财，一些身外物，去背叛我们的初心！”
“加入巡检司的那一刻，加入执法队的那一刻，我们便曾一起宣誓：当为正义执法！当为不公执法！不畏强权，不畏牺牲！”
“正义永存，永不畏惧，永不妥协！”
刘隆说的极其严肃，下一刻，却又露出一丝自嘲之色，有些讥嘲道：“这就是当年的誓言，然而，好像很少有人可以从一而终，一直谨记于心！”
李皓默默倾听。
他和这位不熟，也许正因为不熟，这位才会和自己说这些。
而刘隆没再继续，下一刻转移话题道：“张远的案子，不简单！背后可能涉及到了超能者！”
李皓没有装聋作哑，点点头：“我也这么认为！毕竟六起自焚案，都很自然，甚至我亲眼目睹，普通人很难做到。”
“那你还敢追查？”刘隆忽然笑了，这可能是今晚第一次笑，笑的有些渗人。
李皓不知道，这位是否也和红影有关，可此刻，他没有别的选择和办法。

“张远是我唯一的朋友！”
“为朋友两肋插刀吗？”
刘隆淡淡道：“年轻的时候，都有这样的冲动和热血，也许年纪大一点，想法又不同了！”
说罢，又开口道：“这不重要！你现在有些危险，第一，涉及进入了这起自焚案中！第二，是你揭开了自焚案的序幕，让这起案子进入了执法队视线。第三，今晚你来这，打草惊蛇了，这也是你危险的源头之一。”
“不要指望袁教授可以帮你太多，做人只能靠自己，靠别人，始终都是不靠谱的！”
“袁教授也只是普通人，巡夜人也许卖面子，也许不卖，你不要觉得，只要涉及到超能者，巡夜人就会插手。”
“对巡夜人而言，死6个人算什么？”
刘隆摇头：“不是他们不在乎死人，而是巡夜人数量不多，分布在各地！银城这片区域，巡夜人很少，而且各司其职，除非出现大规模的死伤，巡夜人才会出动。否则，几个人死了，又涉及到了超能者，巡夜人未必有这个功夫理会。”
这是李皓第一次听人认真说起巡夜人这个组织。
李皓压制不住好奇，低声问道：“巡夜人数量不多吗？”
“对！”
刘隆点点头：“数量不多，其实维持治安的，更多的还是巡检司的普通人！只有到了万不得已，巡夜人才会出动，而且还有一点，不是所有超能者，都会加入巡夜人，巡夜人只是超能一系中的一个较大的组织。”
李皓考虑了一下，又问道：“队长，超能者是天生的，还是后天诞生的？”
“都有！”
刘隆玩味道：“你也想接触这个领域？”
“没有。”
“撒谎！”
刘隆嗤之以鼻：“任何人，第一次听说超能，都会向往，因为他们不知道其中的危险，其中的奥秘，只知道，超能神秘，无所不能！只有深入其中，才能明白其中的危机所在，以后后悔有可能，一开始恐怕都会向往。”
李皓只好点头，赞同他的话。
谁听到了这个，都会向往的，他其实也很向往。

“可你一无所知，贸然进入，不说其中难度多大，一窍不通就一头撞进去，恐怕九死一生！”
“恰好……”
刘隆再次笑了起来：“我对巡夜人了解的还算多，你若是来执法队，也许我可以指点你一二。”
李皓古怪道：“队长说这么多，只是为了劝我加入执法队？我只是刚进入巡检司一年的三级巡检，我不认为我有这样的价值，值得队长对我说这么多，甚至涉及超能领域，只是为了让我加入。”
“不要小看自己！”
刘隆眼中带着一些意味深长：“我想让你加入，自然不会那么简单。你也可以认为，借刀杀人！比如说，你的老师，袁硕教授，就是很好的一座靠山！执法队这边，如今积重难返，也许需要一些外力来破开其中的壁垒。”
“你的老师袁硕，是普通人，但是又不全是，银城方面和古院、巡夜人三方，其实都有些仰仗他，帮忙解决一些问题所在。”
李皓默默听着，没有插话。
“这是其一，第二，执法队的确需要一些新鲜血液，你来自古院，是个不错的选择！”
“第三，你够义气，也是我极其看重的一点，起码放心将后背交给你。”
“第四，你有脑子，够细心，培养一番，你可能会成为我的得力助手！”
李皓再次点头。
刘隆笑道：“你觉得呢？这样够了吗？”
够了吗？
李皓觉得，这样的理由，虽然充足，但是也不够充足，起码不能让刘隆这样的人物，一直盯着自己，还特意单独和自己谈话这么多，只为了让自己加入他们。
他看向刘隆，而此刻的刘隆，没有看他。
身材高大的队长，一直盯着天空的方向看，也许是感受到了李皓的目光，忽然笑道：“小家伙，知道太多，其实未必是好事，我想帮你破案，你来帮我，这不就够了吗？何必追根究底呢？”
李皓沉默瞬间，低声道：“我想报仇，但是……我想知道，我究竟在做什么，知道比不知道好！队长说的一切，我都可以理解，可以接受，但是我要知道真相，而不是稀里糊涂地就成了牺牲品！”
“年轻人啊，真沉不住气！”
刘隆笑了起来：“你在张家，是不是取走了什么东西？”

“没有，不明白队长的意思。”
“呵！”
刘隆冷笑：“那烟囱上，好像被人动过手脚，李皓，我是做了二十年巡检的老巡检，我当了十年的执法队长，你可以认为我无能，不能认为我眼瞎！痕迹很新鲜，难不成还是别人动的手脚？”
李皓头皮有些发麻，却是依旧坚持，“我不知道队长说什么，我真没动过任何手脚。”
“无所谓！”
刘隆忽然笑了：“哪怕你取走了什么超能物品，也无所谓，没关系！我不在乎！”
李皓心中诧异，这刘隆，他愈发看不透，也看不懂了。
这位，到底什么意思？
到现在，他其实都有些稀里糊涂的。
刘隆再次笑道：“那就敞开了说，我要你来，因为不好强行调你过来，你有靠山，我不好强行动你，否则……你现在必须跟着我！而不是好言相劝！”
李皓顿时皱眉。
刘隆再次恢复了霸道，冷漠道：“你的老师，还是有些地位的，所以我不能强行对你如何！说这么多，只是想告诉你，你很危险，你也许就是下一个死于自焚的被害人！”
咚咚咚！
心脏陡然跳动起来，剧烈跳动。
李皓心中震撼莫名，刘隆……和红影有关？
“不要想太多！”
刘隆打断了他的思绪，淡淡道：“自焚案，远没有结束！超能者涉足，按理说就算杀人，也早就该离开了，然而，对方却是在银城布局了十年，甚至更长的时间！这不是一场意外杀人，也不是一场仇杀，这是有目标，有目的性的杀人。”
“他们或者他的任务还没结束，对方还有目标，原本我还在想，谁是下一个目标？现在看来，也许就是你了！”
李皓压下悸动，低沉道：“为什么是我？”
“为什么？”

刘隆笑了：“姓李的很多，最近跳的欢的，好像只有你了！我当然要把你的嫌疑提升到最大。”
李皓再次一怔，刘隆……好像也知道那首俚曲！
“那些人盯着张家老宅，也许是为了所谓的张家的刀？”
刘隆这句话，差点让李皓失态。
“张家的刀，李家的剑，都在你手中？”
刘隆又笑了，而李皓，却是再也笑不出来了，只有心寒。
这位，门清！
他好像什么都知道，当然，也许是李皓上报了案子，他才推断了出来，可短短时间，刘隆居然就能查出这么多东西，也是极其可怕的！
“是超能物品吗？”
刘隆自言自语，很快摇头：“不重要，也无所谓！超能物品，对普通人作用不大，他们眼中的宝物，在我们眼中，其实一文不值！你拿走也好，没拿走也好，都无所谓。”
“恰恰相反，你若是拿走了，那最好！”
刘隆笑了：“这样的话，他们的下一个目标，一定是你！百分百是你！布局了这么多年，不可能会放弃，哪怕已经引起了注意，那更不会放弃的！所以，你加入执法队，不单单是帮我，也是在自救！因为你不可能对付超能者。”
李皓不愿意承认这些，只是此刻，他心有些乱了，压下烦躁，低声道：“队长，执法队好像也有对方的眼线……队长说了这么多，难道说……”
“呵！”
刘隆嗤笑：“你在怀疑我？这是应该的，但是没必要，我所做的一切，不是你能理解的，当然，你也许以后可以理解。”
李皓沉声道：“队长有话直说！”
刘隆再次沉默了下来。
许久，轻声叹息一声，很快，又恢复了正常，语气平淡，说出的话，却是让李皓心惊胆战！
“超能者，正如你想的那样，你也想跨入，成为非凡之人！而我……也想！不单单想，甚至我曾经差点就跨入那个领域，可惜，最终我被退回来了！”
“我不甘心，见识了那个领域，你让我退回来，我如何甘心？”

“执法队中的混乱，其实一部分也是我的原因，几年前我安心扎根执法队，所以我勤勤勉勉，可自从被退回来之后……我再也不甘心就此平凡下去！”
“所以我对执法队，少了许多关注，也导致执法队现在鱼龙混杂。”
这些，不是让李皓心惊的原因。
下一句，才是李皓有些想逃的原因。
“我不甘心就此沉沦，不甘心就此和神秘领域擦肩而过……所以，我知道一个办法，可以让我再次跨入超能！那就是……杀超能者！”
刘隆眼神冷厉，瞬间煞气沸腾。
“杀，杀一个和自己属性匹配，或者能力匹配的超能者！剥夺他的神秘能，引入自身，一次不够，那就两次，直到神秘能激发自身的超能，那你就是下一个超能者！”
“超能者少见，而且难杀，每一次都是搏命！可我不愿意就此平凡，最近三年，我们已经猎杀了数位超能者，可惜……我们一直没有成功！”
李皓此刻已经心乱了。
杀超能者，成为新的超能者，他无法相信，也无法想象，一个执法队，居然……居然如此大胆！
李皓头上冒出冷汗。
他知道刘隆为何要自己加入了，甚至知道自己的一些问题，却是不当回事，他甚至更希望自己真的能引来超能者的追杀。
“咕隆！”
李皓咽了咽口水，他觉得自己够胆大了，可今日，他见到了一个更胆大，更疯狂的家伙。
刘隆笑声有些狂放，“怕什么？所以，我不太愿意让巡夜人来参与，至于危险……富贵险中求！不入超凡，难道就此平淡一生？”
“李皓，你也是！你若是想进入超能领域，哪怕你真的加入了巡夜人，但是，你还是很可能被打回来，因为巡夜人只会给你一次机会，引能入体！可巡夜人中，神秘能有限，一次不成，没有第二次机会，你在见识了神秘领域之后，你被打回凡尘，你愿意吗？”
“难道……没人一次能成功？”
李皓问了一句，他想到了自己喝的水，那星光灿烂的能量，是所谓的神秘能吗？
自己好像喝了好多次，可是也没成为超能者，难道说……自己其实一直在引能入体，却是一直没有成功？
“有！”

刘隆微微点头，却是很快自嘲道：“每年，巡夜人在各大城池，起码选拔上万人进入，成为实验者！最终，成功的恐怕只有百分之一！也就是百人左右，剩下的全部失败！李皓，不说银城一年那少数几个实验者名额，就算你能被选中，你觉得，万人当中，你会成为那百人之一吗？”
李皓沉默了。
“所以，只能靠自己！”
刘隆沉声道：“靠自己去杀！用凡尘手段，搏杀超能者！杀了他们，剥夺他们的神秘能，只要匹配自己，一次不行，两次三次，你一定可以成功！”
李皓深吸一口气，这一刻，他再看刘隆，如同看到了疯子。
一个为了成为超能者的普通人，却是不断游走在死亡的边缘，居然去搏杀超能者，这……真的出乎李皓预料。
他觉得自己有这想法，已经够疯狂了。
而眼前这位，不是有这想法，而是明显已经干过这样的事了。
“队长……觉得我能引来超能者？”
“一定可以！”
刘隆这时候也敞开了说：“你别否认，第一眼看到你，我其实就隐约感受到了一些神秘能，你一定近期和超能者或者超能物品有过接触，你这样的人……和超能领域脱不了关系！”
李皓不知道是石头玉剑的影响，还是之前喝了泡剑水的原因，显然，这位队长早就看出了点什么。
可怕的家伙！
一个以凡尘之身，要搏杀超能者，成为超能者的存在。
李皓不知道超能者到底多强，但是他知道，肯定很厉害，红影杀人手段就很可怕，这位可真是……疯狂！
“考虑考虑，随时欢迎你来！”
刘隆忽然从塔楼上跳了下去，声音隐约传来：“不要指望你的老师，你老师没法帮你跨入，甚至他自己都不行，巡夜人也不希望你的老师，或者你老师的学生可以跨入，因为……那不符合他们的利益！”
李皓心中微动，老师……也不行吗？
content_en:
The law enforcement team began to search the Zhang family's old residence.
The result was naturally nothing, and the Zhang family didn’t have anything of value.
But Liu Long understood that the man in secret had been watching here for a long time, and it was absolutely impossible that he didn't have anything important. Or was he waiting for someone?
Who are you waiting for to come to the Zhang family?
However, no one in the Zhang family would come here, except Li Hao, a guy who still cares about the case.
Liu Long, a tall man, wandered around the house with his hands behind his back.
Li Hao and others followed behind. As for the Black Panther, he never left. However, he did not dare to approach Liu Long at this moment, as if he was quite afraid of the law enforcement captain.
Soon, Liu Long approached the kitchen.
The kitchen door has been
Li Hao did not look at the chimney. He replaced a stone on the other side of the chimney. Li Hao tried his best to restore it, but the layer of lime painted on the outside of the chimney had already fallen off, and there was no way to put it back up.
It seems normal for a kitchen that has been in disrepair to lose some lime.
Others barely look up and don't pay much attention.
Liu Long's gaze was extremely sharp. With one glance, the entire kitchen layout came into view. He didn't expect to find anything here, let alone being stared at for so long. There really was some treasure waiting for him to find here.
Just as he was about to look away, Liu Long's gaze froze slightly, and he paused for a moment on the stone that Li Hao had replaced.
Soon, Liu Long looked away.
Without saying anything else, he turned around, glanced at Li Hao, looking down, and said coldly: "Li Hao, did you find anything when you came here?"
"No!"
Li Hao shook his head, thought for a while and then added: "It's not nothing. According to my observation, the entire house has been disturbed, and even the old tree in the yard has been dug up."
"There is a lot of movement, but no one knows about it. Either he is strong, or he is good at covering up!"
Liu Long nodded slightly.
Suddenly he said: "Do you think the people behind the destruction of the Zhang family will show up?"
"Probably not!"
Li Hao chose to tell the truth, "Even if the Zhang family is demolished and the law enforcement team is here, even if the other party is strong, they will not dare to show up easily. That means they are not acting in secret, but against the entire Yincheng!"
"Then do you think it is necessary to continue demolishing this old house? This is the ancestral home left by your friend."
Li Hao perked up. Did Liu Long discover something?
Do you doubt yourself, or do you doubt what the red shadow forces have taken?
Probably doubting yourself!
Without him, Hong Ying's force is still sending people to keep an eye on it. If it really wants to take something away, there may be no need to stay.
In that case, Liu Long might really have doubted himself.
"It's so difficult!"
For such a difficult number one figure, why has Li Hao been given the impression of being somewhat incompetent over the past year?
On the law enforcement team's side, there are only one or two unsolved cases. Otherwise, Li Hao would not feel that the law enforcement team was incompetent even if it were a simple self-immolation case.
Li Hao thought about it and said with some hesitation: "It would be best if you can keep it. If you can't keep it, as long as the murderer can be caught and Zhang Yuan can be avenged, the house is a dead thing. I don't have any problem with it whether it is demolished or burned!"
"That's right!"
Liu Long nodded slightly, and the next moment, he suddenly punched out, and a hole appeared in the kitchen wall. Li Hao's heart trembled when he saw it.
Although the kitchen wall is not made of copper or iron, it is still made of bricks.
When Liu Long punched him, the brick he hit broke and a hole appeared. At this point, Li Hao understood that if he was punched by him, he would not die but would be disabled.
The kitchen, which had been in disrepair for a long time, had holes punched out by Liu Long's punch, and the entire kitchen wall was shaken with plaster falling everywhere.
Liu Long glanced around coldly and said calmly: "Since nothing was found, let's not waste time and demolish the house! Dig three feet into the ground and dig around. If you still don't find anything, light a fire!If you burn it and still don’t find it, then forget it! "
"yes! "
All around, members of the law enforcement team responded, and soon, a rumble sounded.
Liu Long looked at Li Hao again and said calmly: "Would you like to go look for it and leave a few things behind for me to remember? "
Li Hao shook his head gently, sighed, and said a little depressed: "No need! No sense! It would be more valuable to take off the murderer's head and send it to Zhang Yuan's tomb! "
At this moment, how could Li Hao get angry?
If you take away a few things, the whole Zhang family will be deprived of other things, except for the few things Li Hao took away. By then, it will be just yellow mud that will fall off your crotch, and it will be either shit or shit.
Hong Ying's side has never found the Zhang family's knife. At that time, I am afraid that the thing Li Hao took away was the Zhang family's knife.
However, Li Hao really has it!
Liu Long's words may not necessarily be a sign of good intentions.
Maybe it was a test, maybe it was just to kill someone with a borrowed knife, but Li Hao wouldn't take it anyway.
A faint smile suddenly appeared in Liu Long's eyes, and the next moment, he shouted loudly: "Don't smash everything and burn it, bring a few things back to the Inspection Department to use as evidence! "
Li Hao said nothing.
Instead, he quickly judged Liu Long's intention. Was he trying to lure Hongying's party into taking the bait?
At this moment, he would no longer underestimate the law enforcement team or Liu Long, but would carefully analyze the meaning of every word he said.
"The others have dispersed and are looking around! Li Hao, follow me! "
Liu Long dismissed the other team members around him and called Li Hao.
Li Hao didn't ask any questions, just obeyed the order and quickly followed Liu Long.
Liu Long said nothing and strode outside.
Li Hao followed immediately, even walking and running before he could follow.
Outside Zhang's house.
The entire street is full of people at the moment, including people from the law enforcement team and residents of the old street who were alarmed. Although many people have moved away, there are still some people left here.
Liu Long said nothing and continued to move forward.
He walked to a water tower in the middle of the old street, then stopped, then stepped into the water tower and walked directly to the top of the water tower.
Li Hao followed again.
He didn't understand what this person meant, nor why Liu Long came here.
Climb high and look far?
This is the tallest building in the entire old street, but you can see the surroundings clearly. Are you here to observe where the enemy is?
Along the wooden stairs, accompanied by creaking sounds, the two of them climbed all the way up. After a while, they reached the top of the tower.
Below, the old street is in sight.
Liu Long was wearing a black trench coat. The trench coat fluttered in the wind, revealing the densely packed weapons inside the trench coat. To Li Hao's expectation, it was not firearms, but various cold weapons.
A short knife, a delicate silver hatchet, and some throwing knives with extremely small handles.
Liu Long looked up at the sky, not at the crowded old street, and said in an indifferent voice: "Li Hao, you are the inspector of the confidential room. Let me ask you, you have been in the inspection department for a year, what is your biggest impression of the law enforcement team? "
“Can do it! "
Li Hao did not hesitate.
"Ha! "
A sneer came, and Liu Long looked sarcastic, "Hypocritical! Literary men are like this! "
"..."
Speechless.
Liu Long said indifferently: "It's because of incompetence! It's okay to solve some trivial cases, but almost all major cases are unsolved! "
"But, you have to know that the law enforcement team of the Inspection Department has actually been somewhat incompetent in recent years. In the past few years, the Yincheng Inspection Department was the anchor of Yincheng! "
"You are from Yincheng. You should know that when you were a child, Yincheng's public security was the safest among all nearby cities, even if you didn't close your house at night! "
Li Hao thought for a while and nodded.
Also, Yincheng seemed to be very safe when I was a child.
Of course, it may also be related to the fact that he was not exposed to these things when he was a child. At that time, he felt that Yincheng was very safe and there would be no danger.
No matter what he was thinking, Liu Long suddenly said: "Do you know why I want you to join the law enforcement team? ""I don't know..."
"Because of Zhang Yuan!"
"..."
Li Hao frowned, what do you mean?
Liu Long's tone was calm: "Law enforcement team, I have been the captain for ten years, and I have feelings for you! Just like you have feelings for Zhang Yuan, I also have brotherly love for the law enforcement team, and I can't bear to see this brother slowly die!"
"I also wanted to save, but it turned out that the authorities were obsessed with me, and I could no longer clearly control my emotions with my own reason! I know everyone very well, but it is precisely because of this understanding that I feel that no one in the law enforcement team will do anything sorry to me!"
"I don't want to doubt anyone, and I don't want to believe that the brothers who lived and died with me back then would betray our original intentions for some money and some personal belongings!"
"The moment we joined the inspection department, the moment we joined the law enforcement team, we swore together: We will enforce the law for justice! We will enforce the law for injustice! Don't be afraid of power, and don't be afraid of sacrifice!"
"Justice lasts forever, never fear, never compromise!"
Liu Long spoke extremely seriously, but at the next moment, he showed a hint of self-mockery and said sarcastically: "This is the oath we made back then. However, it seems that few people can keep it in mind from the beginning to the end!"
Li Hao listened silently.
He was not familiar with this person, and maybe it was because of his unfamiliarity that this person would say this to him.
But Liu Long did not continue, and changed the subject the next moment: "Zhang Yuan's case is not simple! There may be a superpower behind it!"
Li Hao did not pretend to be deaf and dumb, and nodded: "I think so too! After all, the six cases of self-immolation are all natural. I even witnessed them with my own eyes. It is difficult for ordinary people to do it."
"Then you still dare to pursue it?" Liu Long suddenly laughed. This may be the first time he laughed tonight, and his smile was a little bit charming.
Li Hao didn't know if this person was also related to Hongying, but at this moment, he had no other choice or method.
"Zhang Yuan is my only friend!"
"Going for your friends?"
Liu Long said calmly: "When I was young, I had such impulsiveness and passion. Maybe when I get older, I have different ideas!"
After that, he said again: "It's not important! You are in some danger now. First, you are involved in this self-immolation case! Second, you opened the prelude to the self-immolation case and brought this case into the sight of the law enforcement team. Third, you came here tonight and alerted the snake. This is also one of the sources of your danger."
"Don't expect Professor Yuan to help you too much. You can only rely on yourself, and relying on others is always unreliable!"
"Professor Yuan is just an ordinary person. The night watchman may or may not be trying to save his face. Don't think that as long as superpowers are involved, the night watchman will intervene."
"For a night watchman, what does six dead people mean?"
Liu Long shook his head: "It's not that they don't care about dead people, but the number of night watchmen is small and they are distributed all over the place! In this area of Yincheng, there are very few night watchmen, and they all perform their own duties. Unless there are large-scale casualties, the night watchmen will be dispatched. Otherwise, several people died, and superpowers were involved, and the night watchmen may not have the time to take care of it."
This was the first time Li Hao heard someone seriously talk about the night watchman organization.
Li Hao couldn't suppress his curiosity and asked in a low voice: "Are there not many night watchmen?"
"Yes!"
Liu Long nodded: "There are not many. In fact, the people who maintain law and order are more ordinary people from the Inspection Department! Only when it is absolutely necessary, the night watchman will be dispatched, and another thing is that not all superpowers will join the night watchman. The night watchman is just a larger organization in the super series."
Li Hao thought about it for a moment and then asked: "Captain, are superpowers born or acquired?"
"All of them!"
Liu Long asked playfully: "You also want to get involved in this field?"
"No."
"Lie!"
Liu Long sneered: "Anyone who hears superpowers for the first time will yearn for it because they don't know the dangers involved.The secret is only known, the super power is mysterious and omnipotent! Only by going deep into it can we understand the crisis. It is possible to regret it later, and I am afraid that I will long for it at the beginning. "
Li Hao had no choice but to nod and agree with what he said.
Anyone who hears this will yearn for it, and he actually yearns for it too.
"But if you know nothing about it and rush in, not to mention how difficult it is, if you just rush in without knowing anything about it, you may have a narrow escape from death! "
"Just right..."
Liu Long laughed again: "I know a lot about night watchmen. If you come to the law enforcement team, maybe I can give you some advice. "
Li Hao said strangely: "The captain said so much just to persuade me to join the law enforcement team? I have only been in the inspection department for a year as a third-level inspection officer. I don't think I have such value and deserve the captain to say so much to me, even involving the superpower field, just to let me join. "
"Don't underestimate yourself! "
There was something meaningful in Liu Long's eyes: "If I want you to join, naturally it won't be that simple. You can also think of killing someone with a borrowed knife! For example, your teacher, Professor Yuan Shuo, is a very good supporter! On the law enforcement team's side, it is now difficult to recover, and some external forces may be needed to break down the barriers. "
"Your teacher, Yuan Shuo, is an ordinary person, but not entirely. In fact, Yincheng, Guyuan, and the night watchmen all rely on him to help solve some problems. "
Li Hao listened silently and did not interrupt.
"This is one, and second, the law enforcement team really needs some fresh blood. You are from Guyuan, so you are a good choice! "
"Third, you are loyal enough, which is something I value very much. At least I can trust you with my back. "
"Fourth, if you have brains and are careful enough, if you train yourself, you might become my right-hand man! "
Li Hao nodded again.
Liu Long smiled and said: "What do you think? Is this enough? "
Is that enough?
Li Hao felt that although such a reason was sufficient, it was not sufficient. At least he could not let someone like Liu Long stare at him all the time and talk to him alone so much just to let him join them.
He looked at Liu Long, but Liu Long didn't look at him at this moment.
The tall captain kept staring in the direction of the sky. Perhaps feeling Li Hao's gaze, he suddenly smiled and said: "Little guy, knowing too much may not be a good thing. I want to help you solve the case, so you come to help me. Isn't that enough?" Why bother getting to the bottom of it? "
Li Hao was silent for a moment and whispered: "I want to take revenge, but... I want to know what I am doing. Knowing is better than not knowing! I can understand and accept everything the captain said, but I want to know the truth and not become a victim in confusion! "
“Young man, I can’t hold my breath! "
Liu Long laughed: "Did you take anything away from Zhang's house? "
"No, I don't understand what the captain means. "
"Ha! "
Liu Long sneered: "The chimney seems to have been tampered with. Li Hao, I am an old inspector who has been doing inspections for twenty years. I have been a law enforcement captain for ten years. You can think that I am incompetent, but you can't think that I am blind!" The traces are very fresh, could it be someone else's tampering? "
Li Hao's scalp was a little numb, but he still persisted, "I don't know what the captain said, I really didn't do anything. "
"It doesn't matter! "
Liu Long suddenly smiled: "It doesn't matter even if you take away any super items, it doesn't matter! I don't care! "
Li Hao was surprised. He couldn't understand Liu Long anymore.
What does this guy mean?
Until now, he was actually a little confused.
Liu Long smiled again and said: "Then open up and say, I want you to come, because it's hard to force you to come. You have a backer, so I can't force you to come, otherwise... you must follow me now!" Instead of good words and advice! "
Li Hao suddenly frowned.Liu Long regained his dominance again and said coldly: "Your teacher still has some status, so I can't force you to do anything! I just want to tell you that you are in danger, and you may be the next victim to die of self-immolation!"
Boom, boom, boom!
The heart suddenly started beating violently.
Li Hao was shocked inexplicably. Liu Long... is related to Hongying?
"Don't think too much!"
Liu Long interrupted his thoughts and said calmly: "The self-immolation case is far from over! A superpower is involved. Logically speaking, even if he kills someone, he should have left long ago. However, the other party has been planning it in Yincheng for ten years, or even longer! This is not an accidental killing, nor is it a vendetta. This is a targeted and purposeful killing."
"Their or his mission is not over yet. The other party still has a target. Originally, I was still thinking, who is the next target? Now it seems, maybe it is you!"
Li Hao suppressed his throbbing and said in a low voice, "Why me?"
"Why?"
Liu Long smiled: "There are many people with the surname Li, and it seems that you are the only one dancing happily lately! Of course I will raise your suspicion to the maximum."
Li Hao was startled again. Liu Long... seemed to know that slang song too!
"Those people are staring at the Zhang family's old house, maybe because of the so-called Zhang family's knife?"
Liu Long's words almost made Li Hao lose his composure.
"Both the Zhang family's sword and the Li family's sword are in your hands?"
Liu Long laughed again, but Li Hao could no longer laugh, only feeling chilled.
This is Men Qing!
He seemed to know everything. Of course, maybe he deduced it because Li Hao reported the case, but in a short period of time, Liu Long was able to find out so many things, which is extremely scary!
"Is it a super item?"
Liu Long muttered to himself and quickly shook his head: "It's not important, it doesn't matter! Super items have little effect on ordinary people. The treasures in their eyes are actually worthless in our eyes! It doesn't matter whether you take them away or not."
"On the contrary, it would be best if you took it away!"
Liu Long smiled: "In this case, their next target must be you! It is 100% you! After so many years of planning, it is impossible to give up, even if it has attracted attention, it will not give up! So, when you join the law enforcement team, you are not only helping me, but also saving yourself! Because you can't deal with superpowers."
Li Hao didn't want to admit this, but at this moment, he was a little confused. He suppressed his irritation and whispered: "Captain, the law enforcement team seems to have spies on the other side... The captain has said so much, could it be said..."
"Ha!"
Liu Long sneered: "Are you doubting me? This is right, but it is not necessary. Everything I have done is not something you can understand. Of course, you may be able to understand it in the future."
Li Hao said in a deep voice: "Captain, tell me what you have to say!"
Liu Long fell silent again.
After a long time, he sighed softly, and soon returned to normal. His tone was calm, but the words he said made Li Hao frightened!
"Superpower, just as you think, you also want to step into and become an extraordinary person! And I... want it too! Not only do I want to, I even almost stepped into that field. Unfortunately, I was pushed back in the end!"
"I'm not willing to give in. After seeing that field, you ask me to step back. How can I give in?"
"The chaos in the law enforcement team is actually partly due to me. A few years ago, I settled down to take up my role in the law enforcement team, so I worked diligently. But since I was sent back... I am no longer willing to be ordinary!"
"So I paid less attention to the law enforcement team, which has resulted in a mixed bag of law enforcement teams."
These were not the reasons that frightened Li Hao.
The next sentence was the reason why Li Hao wanted to escape.
"I'm not willing to sink like this, and I'm not willing to just pass by the mysterious realm... So, I know a way to step into super power again! That's...Kill superpowers! "
Liu Long's eyes were cold and stern, and his anger boiled instantly.
"Kill, kill a superpower who matches your own attributes or abilities! Deprive him of his mysterious power and introduce yourself. Once is not enough, then do it twice until the mysterious power inspires your own super power. Then you will be the next superpower! "
"Superpowers are rare and difficult to kill. Every time you fight for your life! But I don't want to be ordinary. In the past three years, we have hunted down several superpowers, but unfortunately... we have never succeeded! "
Li Hao was already confused at this moment.
Killing superpowers and becoming new superpowers, he couldn't believe it, and couldn't imagine that a law enforcement team could... be so bold!
Cold sweat broke out on Li Hao's head.
He knew why Liu Long wanted to join by himself, and even knew some of his problems, but he didn't take them seriously. He even hoped that he could really attract the pursuit of superpowers.
"Gulong! "
Li Hao swallowed. He felt that he was bold enough, but today, he saw a bolder and crazier guy.
Liu Long laughed a little wildly, "What are you afraid of? Therefore, I am not willing to let the night watchman participate. As for the danger... wealth can be found in danger! If you don't enter the extraordinary world, will your life be ordinary? "
"Li Hao, you too! If you want to enter the field of super powers, even if you really join the Night Watch, you are still likely to be beaten back, because the Night Watch will only give you one chance to introduce energy into your body! But among the night watchmen, the mysterious power is limited. If you don't succeed once, there is no second chance. After you have experienced the mysterious realm, you are beaten back to the mortal world. Are you willing? "
"Could it be that... no one can succeed in the first attempt? "
Li Hao asked. He thought about the water he drank. Is that starry energy the so-called mysterious energy?
It seems that I have drunk it many times, but I have not become a superpower. Could it be that... I have been trying to introduce energy into my body, but I have never succeeded?
"Yes! "
Liu Long nodded slightly, but quickly laughed at himself: "Every year, night watchmen select at least tens of thousands of people in major cities to become experimenters! In the end, I’m afraid only one percent will succeed! That's about a hundred people, and the rest all failed! Li Hao, not to mention the few experimenter quotas in Yincheng each year, even if you can be selected, do you think you will become one of the hundred people among ten thousand people? "
Li Hao was silent.
“So, you can only rely on yourself! "
Liu Long said in a deep voice: "Kill on your own! Use mundane means to fight against superpowers! Kill them and deprive them of their mysterious powers. As long as you match yourself, if it doesn't work once, twice or three times, you will definitely succeed! "
Li Hao took a deep breath. At this moment, when he looked at Liu Long, he felt like he was seeing a madman.
An ordinary person who wanted to become a superpower, but kept walking on the edge of death, actually went to fight the superpower. This... was really beyond Li Hao's expectation.
He felt that he was crazy enough for having such an idea.
The person in front of me did not have such thoughts, but had obviously done such a thing.
"Captain...think I can attract superpowers? "
"Definitely! "
Liu Long also opened up at this time and said: "Don't deny it. When I first saw you, I actually vaguely felt some mysterious energy. You must have had contact with superpowers or superpower items recently. People like you... are inseparable from the superpower field! "
